note: ISL: point to own chest (index). Glossed ME in some books.
point to a person or to the location assigned to them
ISL questions put the wh-sign at the END: YOU NAME WHAT
general question sign; on gloves it stands in for the yes/no facial expression the gloves cannot see
time signs come FIRST in an ISL sentence
negation comes LAST: TONIGHT HOME COME NOT
modal after the verb: YOU HELP CAN?
obligation at the end: YOU TICKET MUST
after a verb = completed action (past / perfect)
directional verb: movement from giver to receiver
alone = 'No.'; at the end of a sentence = negation
